notes.title: Patch 3.2.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/892a4167521e8b9530799f78de6661a9d40e8782.jpg

Hi Community 🍞

Patch 3.2.4 is now live! It contains some bug fixes and some quality of life improvements. Feel free to check it out! Thank you for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/84aab2ce67178f48186031c9d3f2f84e00b4d587.png

 Fixed some localization issues in the pause menu. 
 Changed how the final objective for "Pirate Code" was given to avoid being locked out of the quest. 
 Loaf's overworld speed is now set to 0 when getting into a fight with an enemy. 
 Fixed a quest array issue in the save file repair function. Using the save file repair tool while having the quest “Sweet Success” active now functions properly. 
 Changed how the save repair tool fixed the broken progression of the quest "Crow Code" and added an achievement check for the region discounts. 
 The Blessing of Will will now appear in the right place. 
 Modified the conditions to get the golden save file texture. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ec709e9f998d61295828f815145a61c055b7f063.png

 Adjusted the camera volume in the crevasse in Crystal Caves. 
 New icon for switching positions in battles. 
 Replaced one purchasable item in every store in Royal Town with consumables that previously only appeared in crates in this level. 
 Changed the button icon for the 4th party member's ability tutorial. 
 Enemies can no longer trigger a fight while you are in the pause menu. 
 Enemies now have their names displayed underneath them at all times during combat. 
 [hr][/hr] Thank you for your support. If you have any questions or bug reports, please do not hesitate to report them on Steam Community Hub or send your request with your game save file and all the details (videos, screenshots) to support@wildartsgames.com!

notes.title: 🍞 Patch 3.2 is freshly baked 🍞
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/22c60afc5d8a7847e1365fbb9e984bdd3dd5fa59.jpg

Hi there! 🍞
Patch 3.2 is now available!

It includes many bug fixes, quality of life improvements and some fixes concerning several levels and side quests. 

We will continue to gather your feedback and deliver the best gaming experience possible! Feel free to check out the full patch notes below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/84aab2ce67178f48186031c9d3f2f84e00b4d587.png


 Fixed "Well-traveled" achievement being impossible to unlock.
 Fixed "Physiologus" achievement progression becoming stuck, making the achievement impossible to unlock.
 Fixed "Insane Collector" achievement progression becoming stuck on 96/97.
 Fixed "Pro Excavator" achievement counter that sometimes didn't progress when digging some dirt piles.
 Modified the condition to unlock the Blessing of Will.
 Changed the button displayed in the description for Feast.
 Fixed the display of weapon names in the weapon menu.
 Changed the choice box scaling when using a symbol-based language.
 Fixed doors being interactable just after encountering an enemy, causing softlock in combat.
 Fixed doors not stopping Buddies' ability when crossing them, allowing the player to walk around during Lint's ability.
 Fixed dirt mounds items being permanently missable if entering a fight or exiting the level before picking them up.
 Fixed Loaf becoming unable to interact and potentially softlocking if trying to eat an item while using the 4th Buddy's ability.
 Fixed Basement's transition to Secret Cellar displaying a non-localized text.
 Fixed an issue where Loaf was given back the ability to move too soon when buying battle cards in the shop in Chancy Chasm that could result in various blockers.
 Fixed an issue where skipping the last cutscene before chapter 4 could result in a visual bug and a possible blocker.
 Inputs have been disabled during the credits when skipping the last cutscene.
 Can no longer jump into the water while triggering the cutscene in the Great Trunk.
 Fixed Godfrey's quest dialogue bubbles.
 Fixed the check for the golden save file texture.
 Fixed the loading from a save file into the Undergrowth Threshold.
 Changed the default request to a localized line.
 Disabled input on game over buttons clicked and disabled the pause menu after dying from a battle.
 Fixed Boon alphabetical filter button issue for all languages.
 Disabled buddy ability & buddy switch during the trials.
 Disabled enemy encounters when starting a transition to another level.
 Fixed a camera issue when giving an item for all the gathering sidequests.
 Dirt mounds won't spawn duplicate boons.
 Fix the issue where sometimes in Coldstock cottage the walls would disappear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ec709e9f998d61295828f815145a61c055b7f063.png


 Added auto-saves after the peace talks cutscene in Lapwing Village, after Yagi's ability cutscene, after meeting Chloe's family, and after recruiting the fourth party member.
 Fixed an issue where only the equipped buddy was healed when using rest areas.
 Save Repair: Fixes the progression of "Racing Through the Mines" and adds missing sparks to the player's inventory.
 The Holy Highlands map is now unlocked immediately after the introductory cutscene.
 Changed the NPC dialogues in the summit after the campfire segment.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/45f9cff76ee40c5c09e88da9aa2b6986198f7c40.png

 Fixed the objectives for "Racing Through the Mines" being reset when it gets canceled upon triggering a cutscene in Royal Town.
 Give reward for sidequest “The Crow Code” through save fix if needed.
 Save File Repair: added a check for "Sweet Success" to bypass the requirements and let stuck players finish it. Also added a cutscene check for a specific softlock in Royal Town during the Jester segment post chapter 3 caused by old issues.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/2adcdec43211b21ae9c9f6f6b9ff2458e4d8e705.png


 Modified the way the platform in Modern Factory is handled when coming back to the level.
 Tweaked the dialogue radius for Cornelius in Ground Floor, and the Coo in Cackle Coast.
 Fixed collisions in Memory Core allowing the player to continuously respawn out of the map and be softlocked.
 Fixed Shivery Caves' south exit transition being labeled as going to "Shivery Caves" instead of "High-Ice Hamlet".
 Fixed a Save Point in Arteries that sometimes wouldn't work when coming out of the teleporter next to it.
 Fixed transition from Secret Cellar to Basement being labeled as going to "Secret Cellar" instead of "Basement".
 Tweaks to the teleport location of Loaf and the camera volumes in the bakery and in the sewers.
 Fixed out of bounds in the introductory segment of the royal castle.

Thank you for your support. If you have any questions or bug reports, do not hesitate to report them on Steam Community Hub or send your request with your game save file and all the details (videos, screenshots) to support@wildartsgames.com!

notes.title: 🥐 Patch 3.1 is freshly out of the oven! 🥖
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/4e716ca8883594842d33fbb5d22663faf3454dd1.png

Hi there! 🍞

Patch 3.1 is now available! 

It includes many QoL improvements and a new Hard Mode that may increase the replayability of the game! We will continue to gather your feedback and deliver the best gaming experience possible! Feel free to check out the full patch notes below! 

Loaf is loaf-ly, crusti-ly & fresh-ly (that's a mouthful!) arrived on the Custom PS5 Controller! 🎮
Join the giveaway on our Dear Villagers Twitter!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/31c9961659b0a5d68d65e412597f853ab4c71364.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555140/Born_of_Bread/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/84aab2ce67178f48186031c9d3f2f84e00b4d587.png
[olist]
 Loaf can no longer spawn in the water after a fight. 
 Player is no longer able to stamp multiple times during level-up.
 Resolved an issue where using "Defend" repeatedly on the last enemy would make all the chat usernames the same.
 Fixed an issue where butterflies carried Loaf on shorter distances over water when the fourth buddy was equipped.
 Yagi's ability can no longer be used during the Coldstock Cottage boss fight.
 Fixed a blocker that occurred during fights where the buddy died during the same turn as being possessed, thus preventing the combat turn from ending.
 Added safety measures to make sure the user can't switch buddies during fights if the current buddy is possessed.
 Fixed the fourth buddy's dialogue lines during the final celebration.
 Added safety measure when having a game over to make sure the player won't respawn as Jester.
 Fixed an issue with the battle cards that would allow you to equip a null card.
 Changed how the quilt hunt cutscene in the attic is triggered to avoid players missing it.
 Changed the fallback font for special characters. Quotation marks in traditional Chinese are now correctly displayed.
 Fixed a dialogue bubble issue during a cutscene after the Snowstorm fight in the Savers Guild.
 Fixed a potential wrong buddy switch after the boss fight in chapter 3 and 4. 
 Disabled Loaf movement when picking up cards at the shop in Chancy Chasm.
 Tweaked the hydraulic press collisions.
 The weapon hidden in the Royal Castle is now inside a green chest and can't be collected multiple times.
 The Melon can no longer be collected multiple times by talking to Sam the crow.
 Capped the chat speed to prevent hyperspeed.
 Dialogue bubbles now display correctly in the 16:10 aspect ratio. Polish of the text wrapping. 
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ec709e9f998d61295828f815145a61c055b7f063.png
[olist]
 You can now switch between buddies in the overworld with Q or the right bumper on a controller.
 The unlocked maps will now display found salamanders and treasures for each level, as well as the level names.
 The intensity of screen shake effects can now be adjusted down to 0% or up to 200% (if you actually want motion sickness, you do you).
 You can now whack with Right Shift and use the buddy abilities with Right Ctrl on PC. This is now the recommended way to play without a controller.
 In the save file selection menu, there is now a button that will go through your save files and fix potential softlocks or corrupted variables. Fixes include: 

 Unequipping weapons and boons and making sure there are no duplicates.
 Making sure consumables items do not exceed the bag cap.
 Giving the buddies their correct stats and removing non-existent buddies.
 Making sure Loaf isn't saved as being Jester.
 Making sure all the glossary information was added.
  Disabled the mouse in the pause menu and reworked the controls tooltips on PC.
 You can now skip the combat tutorial against the Funguy by skipping the prior cutscene.
 You can now loop through pause menu pages (go from options to weapons directly and vice versa). 
 Moved professor Beryl to a more accessible part of the Outskirts. Professor Beryl and Rita appear in the Outskirts as soon as you can go back into the forest.
 Changed the dialogue lines in the first cutscene with Klein in the Solemn Sepulture.
 In the card glossary menu, players will now see the stacked cards they have collected.
 Hint boards and objects have been placed in Royal Town, Righteous River and Misty Woods, with new lines in all available languages.
 Added sound cues and cameras to the Treasure Rooms objectives.
 Tweaked the spawn physics of clovers in dirt mound actors.
 Added text to the description that appears when picking up boons.
 Updated some button textures for keyboard users.
 Minor changes to some lines of text in various places.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/45f9cff76ee40c5c09e88da9aa2b6986198f7c40.png
[olist]
 Fixed "Can-can... Can" trash pile spawning issue.
 The player now needs to complete the quest "A Taste of Inspiration" before starting "Sweet Success".
 Made the dialogue volume in the campsite in Misty Woods easier to spot.
 Doing the Crystal Mines race before entering Royal Town for the first time after chapter 2 will cancel the race and play the mandatory cutscene.
 Fixed a navigation issue when trying to enter the Shivery Caves with Cecile.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/2adcdec43211b21ae9c9f6f6b9ff2458e4d8e705.png
[olist]
 Fixed how the fourth buddy's ability sequences were skippable in multiple levels.
 Added blocking volumes in the Farmlands to prevent a skip.
 Added blocking volumes to prevent Loaf from getting on the roof of the bakery.
 Fixed a platform in the Biofoundry to allow the player to backtrack if entering the level after defeating the mini-boss.
 Added a blocking volume in the Forgotten Vault to prevent the player from going out of bound and get softlocked.
 Fixed an out of bounds in the Hidden Springs.
 Adjusted one of the fourth buddy's ability that was hard to hit in Crow's Nest.
[/olist]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ff0499cd739986a50c6942f28a9bf5f188b532e9.png
[olist]
 Ember melee damage raised from 3 to 4.
 Slightly lowered chances of consumables dropping from whackables.
 Lowered chances of consumables dropping from defeated enemies.
 Weakness damage is now x1.5 instead of x2.
 Adjusted the number of enemies in battles, especially in chapter 4.
 Switched the resistance of the potbelly flare with Amelie doll's resistance. 
 New hard mode available when creating a save file:


 Less frames to block and faster animations.
 Enemies, mini-bosses, and bosses have more HP.
 Enemies deal more damage and have more defense.
 There are more enemies per fight.

[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 3.0: tasti-ily bread-ily baked! 👨‍🍳
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/dc4054d0abee4f6a9b1e9ddc656ecc66539c11f8.png

Hi there! 🥖

Thank you for all your love & support for Born of Bread! Hopefully, you have had your own ''Bready'' moment! 🍞

Since the first week of release, we have been receiving your bug reports/suggestions about the game.

This patch contains a lot of fixes & QOL improvements. We also fixed a lot of side-quest issues that most players were experiencing.

We plan to release another patch later on that will focus on QOL and accessibility, stay tuned! 😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/84aab2ce67178f48186031c9d3f2f84e00b4d587.png
[expand type=details]

 Placed the correct palette boon for Dub in the dirt mound in Righteous River, 4th partner in a dirt mound on Numbskull Island, Chloe in a chest in the Optics. 
 Fixed Battle Broadcast viewer reaction to attacks. 
 Boon slots can now be increased to 8. 
 Adjusted max backpack level achievable by leveling up. 
 Loaf can no longer pick up consumable items while entering a cutscene. 
 Loaf will never respawn on a raft, thus avoiding him spawning underwater. 
 Cleared palette boons array when creating a new save to prevent awkward carry over from another save. 
 "Hide chat" display text on Battle Broadcast will now properly update between fights. 
 Sprinting shoes now carry through level transitions. 
 Prevented "HP up+" from respawning though the gold barrel in Crow’s Nest & in the popcorn machine on First Floor. 
 Fixed Boon Filter issues. 
 Buddy Health up added to buddy stats when acquiring a new buddy. 
 Patched healing function in item card to use the same one as elsewhere. 
 Fixed a blocker that occurred where the End Combat Screen wouldn't trigger after defeating an enemy on the first loop of a multiple attack and then missing the last one. 
 Resolved several items storage issues when buying from a vendor. 
 Fixed a blocker where Loaf and Jester segment would be blocked if you triggered the cutscene by falling into the sewer water. 
 Roast special ability buddy selection is now disabled. 
 Changed the event requiring successive button inputs to prevent last input spamming. 
 Followers are now saved when saving the game. 
 Fixed two items being able to be hooked by the last buddy's ability in the teleportation hub. 
 You can't stamp outside of the cards during a level up.
 Fixed an issue with the camera when the player jumps on the guard prohibiting you from going into the Forest of Roots. 
 Fixed a crash in the Chinese version and an unlocalized texture in the Spanish version. 
 Fixed an issue where Loaf couldn't jump after buying items in different shops. 
 Added new salamanders in the Attic, Courtyard, Righteous River and Drone Hive. 
 WP gain values acquired through the "Perfect timing boon" will now display as round numbers. 
 Added safety nets in case the player enters Llama Village by Chancy Chasm before going through Bamboo Forest. 
 You can no longer control the skill tree tab while being in the party tab. This lead to potentially equipping skills from one buddy onto another. 

[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ec709e9f998d61295828f815145a61c055b7f063.png
[expand type=details]

 Added an auto save after getting Dub for the first time, and one before and after each boss fight. 
 Made the mounds of dirt Lint can interact with easier to spot. 
 Enemies no longer throw projectiles at you in Righteous River to avoid getting snipped above water. 
 Fixed the Undergrowth elevator not going down after the campfire segment in the Outpost and added an invisible wall after the Logling fight to avoid sequence breaking. 
 Added a Buddy Filter to chat comments to prevent chat members from spoiling future buddies. 
 Changed default choice input to "Yes". 
 Fixed the issue where some NPCs would keep talking after their dialogues were over. 
 Added out-of-bounds player respawn to all levels. Falling out of levels will now respawn Loaf to the most recent player start. 
 Papa Baker and Lint do not overlap anymore after the first cutscenes. 
 Minor polishing touches. 
 Snowstorm's quest can now be started earlier in the story progression. 
 When the professors give you the data and map upgrades, you'll now see an appropriate menu notification. 
 Added support for 1280x800 resolution on PC and Steam Deck. (note that Dynamic Cloud synch between PC & Steam Deck is not implemented yet)
 Loaf recovers faster from falling into water. 

[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/45f9cff76ee40c5c09e88da9aa2b6986198f7c40.png
[expand type=details]

 If you start a follower side quest before playing Jester segments or major story beats in Royal Town, the follower will let you go to Royal Town, but they will be destroyed and the quest will go back to the first objective to avoid conflicts. 
 Fixed conflict issues between the side quest followers. 
 "The Way of the Goat", "Sweet Success" and "The Crow Code" quest can now be completed. 
 Fixed successful ending of "Racing Through Town", "Racing Through the Caves" and "Racing Through the Nest". 
 "Can-can... Can" quest: Trash piles will now spawn if the player reloads the level. 
 Fixed a blocker that occurred when interacting with the paper in front of Lint's house while Yagi was still using his ability to reveal the lotus to access the house. 
 Llana in Royal Town now shows her quest bubble and will now sell Mochi instead of the Jelly Donut. 

[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/2adcdec43211b21ae9c9f6f6b9ff2458e4d8e705.png
[expand type=details]

 Fixed a level skip in Boreal Bridge. 
 Fixed out of bounds in the Deep Mines. 
 Fixed out of bound respawn location in Ancient Archives. 
 Added missing collisions in Sunken Spires. 
 Raised the camera distance when close to hazards in various levels. 
 Moved some snow piles in Boreal Bridge. 
 Fixed blocker issues related to house doors in Lapwing and Llama villages. 
 Fixed some collisions issues that allowed the player to go out of bounds in the Library which could result in a blocker. 
 Fixed some collisions issues that could result in a blocker where the player was stuck behind open doors on the Manor's Ground Floor. 
 Fixed Collision Issues with Cottage vestibule's locked door. 
 Fixed wrong collisions on the Ancient Archives walls. 
 Fixed an out of bounds in the Badger Mines. 

[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ff0499cd739986a50c6942f28a9bf5f188b532e9.png
Lint Balancing

 Cautionary Tale bored chances lowered from 100% to 90% 
 Cinder Spin WP cost raised from 3 to 4 
 Cautionary Tale WP cost raised from 3 to 4 
 Cliff Hanger WP cost raised from 5 to 6 


Yagi Balancing

 Blazing Vortex WP cost raised from 6 to 7 
 Mind Prison WP cost raised from 8 to 9 


Chloe Balancing  

 Icy Stare bored chances lowered from 100% to 90% 
 Best Served Cold bored chances lowered from 50% to 35% 
 Sarcasm WP cost raised from 3 to 4 
 Best Served Cold WP cost raised from 5 to 6 
 Alibi will now correctly hit only once
 

Fourth Buddy Balancing

 To The Brig bored chances lowered from 60% to 40% 
 Guitar Riff bored chances lowered from 100% to 80% 
 Knockout base DMG lowered from 3 to 2 
 Knockout bored chances raised from 20% to 40% 
 Rock the boat WP cost raised from 8 to 9 


Enemies Balancing 

 Bosses are now immune to “bore”
 Charcuff HP was raised from 4 to 5 
 Oreling attack loops raised from 1 to 2 
 Honey Slime HP was raised from 4 to 5 
 Ruckus Drum HP raised from 4 to 6 
 Amélie Doll HP raised from 7 to 8 
 Imp HP raised from 7 to 8 

Thank you for all your support! Enjoy and have fun!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1 - Gameplay Insights
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/673d7c31f93c006ae6afb68632e445ac896c433b.png

Hello there!

Welcome to the first dev blog of Born of Bread! Are you ‘’bready’’ for the release on December 5th? Loaf and his buddies can’t wait to meet you in the frosty winter! 🥶

Without further ado, let’s dive in!
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/dc94bd283786d6457de123c07f4a6c76dd8eecf8.png

The ''bready'' recipe actually came from our idea to make a ''fun & quirky'' RPG after our first published game – Helltown in 2017.  At that time, we replayed some of the classics, taking inspiration from Paper Mario in particular: The Thousand Year Door!

As time went on, we had a lot of discussions about how to develop and twist the 'Paper RPG formula' based on these classics. We started creating funny characters, one of which you can see everywhere - Loaf, and then the other party members.
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/6b2a4c81627bfd747698b3daa43be6d89fe30f57.png
Fun & Light-hearted play style! 
Born of Bread isn't just about meeting buddies and solving quests. There’s a lot more to it than you can imagine. 

In the game, you can pet any animals that you encounter! For example, you can pet a dog and... a panda! 🐼 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/94f7edd838bc78f466542caec11a4557042df6ef.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/d0313ad18993110acd7e3bea16e7f4197d15783b.gif

Playing as Loaf, you will meet a wonderful cast of buddies on your journey. They all have their own personalities, special abilities, favourite pastimes, and foods! Get to know them better this winter!

In the game, each Buddy's special ability can help you explore the map and unlock different locations for your quests! 

WAIT, WAIT, WAIT! Did you know that Dub's tunic is an over-sized t-shirt? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/580e62d61202d5365581eaf4c56ad4a9ae057955.png

Conversations and cutscenes are also worth watching! Why is that? Simply because you have...

This 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/36dbff190644132078eb9b30af5aae7febfd6bc9.png

And that 👇 Remember to wishlist the game on Steam and save the raccoon … 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/7402cd52596f8826719e500d9c45b8646a7ffcaa.png

Taking Lint (the raccoon) as an example, after he gets lost, Loaf and Papa Baker are the first people he meets. If you played the demo, you’ll see that he decided to join them on their adventure and hopefully find his family but there is so much more for you to discover about his relationship with his other buddies! 
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/ebe7cd02a085bbbca8e0c6cf19ca9e713c155edd.png

Combat actions are represented by button commands. For example, if you want to attack and deal extra damage to your enemies, you will need to press and hold that button at a specific time! 

This means you can't just press an action and wait for the character to do the rest. You must pay attention and try to follow the instructions, otherwise you may not be able to win the battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/2724b96e6f721c4c29fc28f223977086e6f52d32.png

There is another interesting mechanic called ‘’Battle Broadcast’’. 

If you have a lot of viewers and do well in the fight, you'll receive helpful bonuses from the Battle Broadcast to help you out in a pinch. 

The battle will be broadcast and moderated by Dub to the NPCs you'll meet along the way. As you can see from the chat, they will be constantly commenting on the action in a fun and hilarious way. In addition, if you have a large audience and perform well in combat, you can earn useful rewards that can help you in times of need.

As you can see, Dub is hard-working and dedicated to his job... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40368768/c6661c6e845715cbd149af5130f54bd16176fd49.png

Thank you for reading. We hope you enjoy it! 

Mark your calendars for the 5th of December, when the game will be completely baked ^^

See you soon!

WildArts Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555140/Born_of_Bread/

If you want to find out more, check out the articles below and watch the interview between us and Chi-Chi on YouTube!
